_about: Round 89b (owner): every line the projected #1 (Drako Dragic) and #2 (Chinmaya Jagadeesh) say, plus the mystery call. Edit freely. Placeholders: {you} your first name, {n1} #1's name, {n2} #2's name, {height} #2's height, {big} 'a center' / 'a four'. No em dashes.

combine.text: Did... somebody check the vanes? He cleared the top one.
Yo. What's going on? Who is that?
That's {n2}. {height}, {big}, and he moves like a guard. Athletic freak.
Projected second overall. Every time he does that, the scouts lose their minds.
Relax, {you}. I'm messing with you. Kind of. Good luck at the scrimmage, man. Hope we're on the same team.
All right, settle down. That's it for today. We'll be in touch.

scrimmageIntro.one: Look at that. Same team, {you}. Just get me the ball and we'll be fine.
scrimmageIntro.two: YOU! YEAH, YOU! I'M COMING FOR YOU ALL GAME!

niceHim: Told you we'd be on the same team.
one.halfDown: How are we losing? This is getting ridiculous.
snakeYou: Wow. Great shot... for a second-rounder.
See? You can hit one. Sometimes.
Keep shooting. Really. It's helping. Somebody.
snakeThem: It's cool. Somebody has to be the guy we lose with.
Don't worry. I'll make sure the scouts see you... trying.
We're fine. I'm fine, at least.
snakeMiss: Maybe pass it to the first overall pick next time?

scores: GET OFF ME! GET OFF ME!
blocks: NOT IN MY HOUSE! NOT EVER!
SEND IT BACK! SEND IT ALL BACK!
GET THAT WEAK STUFF OUTTA HERE!
youScore: DO THAT AGAIN. I DARE YOU.

mysteryCall.text: Give up on basketball. It's not for you.
